name: Kyouiku Shidou 3 ~Yamato Nadeshiko Saishuu Keikaku~
original_name: 狂イク指導3～大和撫子最終計画～
source:
There is a secret organization. The purpose of it is to train girls and make them modest and obedient. Girls who are regarded as violators are taken to a secret base and sexually assaulted in various ways. It never ends until they change.... Target girls this time are a gravure idol and a miko....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090712030931/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012800]ErogeShop[/url]]
